questions.question: What do plants need most to grow from a seed?
questions.explanation: Plants use water and sunlight to make their own food and grow big!
questions.funFact: Some giant redwood trees can grow taller than a 30-story building!

questions.question: What falls from the dark clouds when it is raining?
questions.explanation: Rain is liquid water that falls when clouds get too heavy.
questions.funFact: A raindrop falls at a speed of about 14 miles per hour!

questions.question: Which animal says 'Moo' and gives us milk?
questions.explanation: Cows produce milk, which we use to make cheese, butter, and yogurt.
questions.funFact: A cow chews its food about 40,000 times a day!

questions.question: What shines brightly in the sky during the day and keeps us warm?
questions.explanation: The Sun gives Earth light and warmth so living things can survive.
questions.funFact: The Sun is actually a giant star, and it's super hot!

questions.question: Which of these animals has feathers and can fly in the sky?
questions.explanation: Birds have wings and feathers that help them fly through the air.
questions.funFact: Hummingbirds can fly backwards and even upside down!

questions.question: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.explanation: Spiders are arachnids, which means they all have eight legs.
questions.funFact: Most spiders have eight eyes too, but they don't see very well!

questions.question: What color are most leaves on a tree during the summer?
questions.explanation: Leaves are green because of a special chemical called chlorophyll.
questions.funFact: In autumn, the green color fades away, showing red, yellow, and orange!

questions.question: What is the very cold, hard form of water called?
questions.explanation: When water gets freezing cold, it turns into solid ice.
questions.funFact: Ice is actually lighter than water, which is why it floats in your drink!

questions.question: Which large animal has a long trunk and big ears?
questions.explanation: Elephants use their long trunks to grab food, drink water, and even hug!
questions.funFact: An elephant's trunk has over 40,000 muscles in it!

questions.question: What do we use our eyes for?
questions.explanation: Eyes capture light and send pictures to our brain so we can see.
questions.funFact: Your eyes blink around 15 to 20 times every single minute!

questions.question: Which of these is a fruit that is long, yellow, and curved?
questions.explanation: Bananas grow in bunches on large plants in warm places.
questions.funFact: Bananas actually float if you put them in water!

questions.question: What comes out at night and twinkles in the dark sky?
questions.explanation: Stars are giant balls of glowing gas far away in space.
questions.funFact: There are more stars in the sky than grains of sand on all the beaches on Earth!

questions.question: Which part of a plant grows deep under the dirt?
questions.explanation: Roots hold the plant in place and drink up water from the soil.
questions.funFact: Some tree roots can stretch out wider than the tree is tall!

questions.question: What do caterpillars turn into after they sleep in a chrysalis?
questions.explanation: Caterpillars transform into beautiful butterflies with colorful wings.
questions.funFact: Butterflies actually taste their food using their feet!

questions.question: Which of these animals lives completely under the water?
questions.explanation: Fish have special parts called gills that let them breathe underwater.
questions.funFact: Some fish, like the great white shark, never stop swimming, even when they sleep!

questions.question: What invisible gas do we breathe in to stay alive?
questions.explanation: We breathe air to get oxygen, which our bodies need to work.
questions.funFact: You take about 20,000 breaths every single day without even thinking about it!

questions.question: What beautiful, colorful arch can you sometimes see in the sky after it rains?
questions.explanation: Rainbows happen when sunlight shines through tiny raindrops in the air.
questions.funFact: You can never reach the end of a rainbow because it moves with you!

questions.question: What season is very cold and often brings snow?
questions.explanation: Winter is the coldest season when days are shorter and it can snow.
questions.funFact: Every single snowflake has its own unique, beautiful shape!

questions.question: What do birds build out of twigs and grass to lay their eggs in?
questions.explanation: Birds carefully weave nests to keep their eggs warm and safe.
questions.funFact: Some birds 'glue' their nests together using spiderwebs!

questions.question: What sweet treat do bees make from flower nectar?
questions.explanation: Bees collect nectar and turn it into honey to feed their hive.
questions.funFact: A single honeybee will only make about one-twelfth of a teaspoon of honey in its entire life!
